data.body: Patch set 1 of Gerrit change 3159: LLM-Review +1, Verified -1. The failure was in make lint's online zizmor audit (GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 on pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish v1.14.2 in release.yml), outside this change; main already fixed it in 778c969e4f1. Rebased onto origin/main and pushed patch set 2 (c9c84d18761), which also adds the two tests the LLM review suggested: every non-supersedes relation still refuses a closed source at add_dependency, and depends_on still refuses a closed target.
